parameters.content:
## FANA 02 - Arabic Qualification Agent
LLM proposes, code decides. GPT-4o (Azure, JSON mode) writes the Arabic reply + an extraction with evidence quotes. Core Engine validates schema, allowed values and evidence, re-parses budgets, merges changes with history, re-scores, and blocks replies with invented prices (falls back to a safe template). LLM failure -> template reply, lead still saved.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $json.system_prompt }, { role: 'user', content: $json.user_prompt }], temperature: 0.3, max_tokens: 700, response_format: { type: 'json_object' } }) }}

nodeGroups.name: Validate & Remember
nodeGroups.description: Core Engine validates and scores the AI output, then both turns are stored as conversation state.
